title: I Love the Mountains
transcription:
I Love the Mountains

I love the mountains,
I love the rolling hills,
I love the fountains,
I love the daffodils,
I love the fireside
when the lights are low.

Boom-de-yaddah, boom-de-yaddah,
Boom-de-yaddah, boom-de-yeah.
(repeat boom-de-yaddah twice after each
time through)
